title: Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.05442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006

translated_title: 匹配但并不更优：六个临床数据集上量子机器学习的等效性检验基准及QML-Health-READY报告框架
translated_abstract: 背景：量子机器学习（QML）被推广用于临床预测，但与传统模型的比较很少采用配对设计或进行等效性检验。方法：我们在六个公开临床数据集上，将量子核支持向量机（QSVM；4量子比特，调优带宽）和变分量子分类器（VQC）与五个调优后的经典模型进行比较。所有模型使用相同的四分量输入和25次交叉验证划分。采用校正的重采样t检验、经Holm校正的等效性检验（边际：±0.02和±0.05）以及随机效应合并分析来评估配对AUROC差异。此外还进行了消融实验、噪声、有限采样次数和实现故障分析。我们提出了QML-Health-READY，一个包含八个领域的报告框架。结果：两种量子模型均未显著优于任何经典对照模型。在各数据集上合并后，QSVM与核匹配的径向基函数（RBF）SVM的差异仅为-0.006
tldr: 该研究通过严格的配对等效性检验，在六个临床数据集上证明量子机器学习模型（QSVM和VQC）并不优于调优后的经典机器学习模型，并提出QML-Health-READY八领域报告框架以规范QML临床研究的报告标准。
en_tdlr: Through rigorous paired equivalence testing on six clinical datasets, this study demonstrates that quantum machine learning models (QSVM and VQC) do not outperform tuned classical models, and proposes the eight-domain QML-Health-READY reporting framework to standardize QML clinical research reporting.
